text:
Reef in the daring, winged sail,
Palinurus, who saw the furious sea;
it would be an insult (the powerful do that)
just to see you armed for your defense.

Let the oar fall silent, even the vow be still;
working is idle when the hour is right.
Effort is wasted on one destined for happiness,
if that is to come through being forgotten.

Surrender is a wise sacrifice
where resistance cannot prevail;
frustrated fury lasts and grows.

For heaven did not make violence
so absolute—and still less when wind arms it—
that in the end it cannot be overcome by obedience.

translation.title: Reef In the Daring Winged Sail
